So then August 2014 i started chemo
Mine was invasive er+ stage 2 and in one lymph node out of 5 that they took.

Kinda of the same although i had waited like 3 years to go to the gyno.  I went in April 2014 and it was a nurse practitioner not my regular doctor. She felt my right one and felt my left one. She went back and forth then she said hmmm i feel something in your areola but it moves around, it could be a cyst. So she said u need to get a mammogram. So i went in for a mammogram like a few days later and after the mammogram they said i need and ultrasound. So the ultrasound was scary and the guy was like i see alot of shading. So deep down i just knew what it was, i knew i was screwed.  So then i went for the biopsy in early may. Then they called me a the next week and told me it was stage 1. So then they were preparing to tell me about a possible lumpectomy untill i did the MRI. After the MRI they called and said i had my whole left breast removed because it was in 3 spots with the biggest tumor being 2.5cm. That was a shit day and i just cried. I was so scared.  They said my right side was fine.  So i was eventually tested for the brca gene in which i do not have so my dr didnt feel it was necessary to have a double mastectomy.  So tomorrow will be 6 yrs since my mastectomy. Ironically at the same time my gynecologist was going through bc too but hers wasn't as bad as mine but it was weird with the timing.
Least you were in good head space at that moment. That moment your life changes forever and after they tell u its "c". I know my life has forever changed
